z-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Ihuwandu hwakasikwa kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
z-m-36-01.title: Mamiriro maviri anotungamira kunzvimbo imwe chete: hukama hwavo kune mumwe ndehupi?
z-m-36-01.topic: Zvaunogona nezvausingagoni kuziva kana mamiriro maviri achitungamira kumamiriro mamwe chete (inclusion ye truth sets)
z-m-36-01.goal: Kubva paruzivo rwekuti 'kana p saka q' ne 'kana r saka q' zviri zvechokwadi chete, rongedza zvirevo zvakatarwa nezvisina kutarwa nekuisa truth sets, ratidza zvisina kutarwa nemienzaniso inopikisa, uye utaure kuti chii chimwe chaunofanira kuziva kuti uzvitare.
z-m-36-01.material:
Ne universal set U, funga mamiriro matatu p, q, r. Rega truth sets dzawo dzive P, Q, R. Zvauri kuziva ndezviviri izvi chete.
(가) Chirevo 'kana p saka q' chechokwadi. (P ndi subset ye Q.)
(나) Chirevo 'kana r saka q' chechokwadi. (R ndi subset ye Q.)
Hapana chinozikanwa nezve hukama pakati pe P ne R. Kuti unzwisise nemashoko oga, pasina pikicha, unogona kuidhirowa se 'P iri mukati me Q uye R iri mukati me Q zvakare'.
z-m-36-01.thinking.1: Kutonga nekushandura mamiriro kuita inclusion ye truth sets
z-m-36-01.thinking.2: Kugadzira iwe pachako mienzaniso inopikisa kuratidza 'hazvigari zviri zvechokwadi'
z-m-36-01.thinking.3: Kutaura kuti ruzivo rupi rwunoshaikwa kuti mhedziso itarwe
z-m-36-01.prereq.0: Kuti kana chirevo 'kana p saka q' chiri chechokwadi, truth set P ndi subset ye Q, uye kuti contrapositive ine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chekutanga (tichifungidzira kuti mudzidzi akadzidza chikamu chekutanga che Common Mathematics 'sets and propositions'; H2 inongova label yekuoma yebasa iri rekugadzira, kwete kugoverwa kwegiredhi)
z-m-36-01.prereq.1: Zvinoreva union, intersection ne complement, nema multiples nema divisors
z-m-36-01.s.s1.prompt: Uchiziva (가) ne (나) chete, sarudza zvirevo zvose zvaunogona kutara sezvichigara zviri zvechokwadi. (Usasarudze zvirevo zvisingagoni kutarwa.)
z-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa mapikicha maviri kana kupfuura akasiyana aine P ne R imwe neimwe yakaiswa mukati me Q. (Semuenzaniso, pikicha umo zvinofukidzana, neimwe umo zvisingafukidzani.)
z-m-36-01.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora zvakare chirevo chimwe nechimwe se inclusion senge 'P ndi subset ye Q' uye utarise kana chiri chechokwadi mupikicha imwe neimwe yawakadhirowa. Pane chirevo chine chokwadi chinochinja zvichienderana nepikicha here?
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.a: Zvose zvinozikanwa ndezvekuti P ne R dziri mukati me Q. Kuva mukati meseti imwe chete hakureve kuti imwe inosanganisira imwe. Dhirowawo mapikicha umo maseti maviri asingafukidzani kana imwe chete yakakura.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.b: Kana kuti q, saka kuti p
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.b: Wakaverenga (가) yakashandurwa kuita contrapositive yayo. Kutonga uku kunoshandisa chokwadi chekuti contrapositive ine chokwadi chakafanana nechirevo chekutanga.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.c: Iyi ndiyo converse ye (나). Kunyange chirevo chiri chechokwadi, converse yayo inogona kuva yechokwadi kana yenhema. Dhirowa pikicha umo Q inogona kuva hombe kupfuura R.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.d: Kana p kana r, saka q
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kana chikamu chakabatanidzwa che P ne R chinokodzera mukati me Q. Kana imwe neimwe iri mukati me Q, musanganiswa uri mukati me Q zvakare.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.e: Kana p uye r, saka q
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.e: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kana chikamu chakafanana che P ne R chinokodzera mukati me Q. Chikamu chakafanana chingori chikamu che P. Funga zvakare nyaya apo chikamu chakafanana chiri chisina chinhu.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.o.f: Kana kuti r, saka kuti p
z-m-36-01.s.s1.r.f: Chirevo ichi ndiyo contrapositive ye 'kana p saka r'. Kana chirevo icho chisina kutarwa, ichi hachitarwi zvakare.
z-m-36-01.s.s1.explain: Zvinotarwa kubva ku (가) ne (나) zvinongova zvinotevera zvakananga kubva ku P⊂Q ne R⊂Q. 'Kana kuti q, saka kuti p' ndiyo contrapositive ye (가), 'kana p kana r, saka q' ndi P∪R⊂Q, uye 'kana p uye r, saka q' ndi P∩R⊂Q. Kune rimwe divi, 'kana p, saka r' (P⊂R) necontrapositive yayo, ne 'kana q, saka r' (Q⊂R), zvinogona kuva zvechokwadi kana zvenhema zvichienderana nekuti P, R, ne Q zvakaiswa sei, saka hazvitarwi neruzivo urwu oga. 'Hazvina kutarwa' kwakasiyana ne 'nhema'.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.prompt: Zvino ngatitarisei nyaya chaiyo. Universal set U ndi nhamba dzechisikigo kubva ku1 kusvika ku30. q ndi 'ndi even', p ndi 'ndi multiple ye4', uye r ndi 'ndi multiple ye6'. Ipapo (가) ne (나) zvose zviri zvechokwadi. Tsvaga uye uise nhamba 3 dzakasiyana x apo p iri yechokwadi asi r iri yenhema.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wanyora nhamba dzose kubva ku1 kusvika ku30 dzinogutsa mamiriro p (ma multiples e4).
z-m-36-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kune nhamba imwe neimwe yawakanyora, tarisa mamiriro r (kana iri multiple ye6), uye uchengete nhamba dzisingaagutsi chete.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.var.x: x (natural number kubva ku1 kusvika ku30)
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c1: x inofanira kuva natural number kubva ku1 kusvika ku30.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Haisi multiple ye4, saka p haisi yechokwadi.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Haisi multiple ye6, saka r yenhema.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Imultiple ye6, saka r yechokwadi. Inofanira kuva nhamba umo r iri yenhema.
z-m-36-01.s.s2.explain: Kubva ku1 kusvika ku30, ma multiples e4 ndi 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, uye kubvisa 12 ne24, ari ma multiples e6, kunosiya 4, 8, 16, 20, 28, dzinokodzera mamiriro. Kana pane kunyange nhamba imwe yakadaro, 'kana p saka r' yenhema. Kunyange munyaya iyi (가) ne (나) dzichiri dzechokwadi, saka zvakasimbiswa kuti (가) ne (나) oga haagoni kutara 'kana p saka r'.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.prompt: Jiho akati, "p ne r dziri mukati me q, saka 'kana p saka r' inofanirawo kuva yechokwadi." Nyora zvaunofunga nezvechirevo chaJiho. Nyorawo kana zvawakatanga kusarudza mu s1 zvakachinja (kana zvakaramba zvakadaro) mushure mekuita s2, uye unyore kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera runodiwa kutara kuti 'kana p saka r' ndeyechokwadi.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.0: Sarudza imwe yenhamba dzawakagadzira mu s2 uye tanga wanyora kana p ne r imwe neimwe iri yechokwadi kana yenhema.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.hint.1: Funga kuti chirevo chimwe chakabatanidza p ne r zvakananga chaizova nechimiro chipi, uye utarise kana nhamba yawakangosarudza ichigoneka kana chirevo icho chiripo.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Chirevo chaJiho ndi ... nekuti ... Kuchitara ...
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Munhamba yandakapa, unogona kuona zvakajeka kuti p yechokwadi uye r yenhema here?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakanyora 'hazvigoni kutarwa' ne 'inhema' sezvinhu zvakasiyana here?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Dai ruzivo rwekuwedzera randakataura rwaivapo, ndakatarisa nemuenzaniso mumwe kuti 'kana p saka r' inova yechokwadi chaizvo here?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.selfAssess.3: Kana zvandakatanga kusarudza mu s1 zvakachinja, ndakanyora kuti nei zvakachinja, uye kana zvakaramba zvakadaro, pahwaro hupi here?
z-m-36-01.s.s3.model.0: Chirevo chaJiho hachigoni kutarwa. 4 imultiple ye4, saka p yechokwadi, asi haisi multiple ye6, saka r yenhema. Zvakadaro (가) ne (나) dzinoramba dziri dzechokwadi, saka kuva mukati me q oga hakukwani. Tinoda chimwe chinhu chinobatanidza p ne r zvakananga, senge ruzivo rwekuti P iri mukati me R.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Kana hauna kusarudza 'kana p saka r' pakutanga, inyaya apo kutonga kwako kwakaramba kwakadaro, uye unogona kunyora kuti kutarisa nemuenzaniso kwakaita kuti chivimbo chako chikure.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.model.1: Handigoni kuziva kana iri yechokwadi. 16 imultiple ye4 asi haisi multiple ye6, saka muenzaniso unopikisa. Asi kana tikadzidzawo 'kana q saka r', saka P iri mukati me Q uye Q iri mukati me R, saka P iri mukati me R zvakare, uye 'kana p saka r' inova yechokwadi. Pakutanga zvaiita sezvichava zvechokwadi, asi ndakawana muenzaniso unopikisa ndikachinja pfungwa.
z-m-36-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mhinduro inopa ruzivo rumwe rutsva uye inotaurawo kuti nei rwakakwana. Nyaya R=Q inova 'kana q saka r' kana yabatanidzwa ne (나), saka imwe nzira yekutaura mhinduro imwe chete.
